name: Yagami Iori
source:
2nd year university student.
A bassist that often does live shows. An extreme person who always causes trouble when he gets near Kyou.
The protagonist's friend Kaori is a huge fan and drags her to one of his live shows where they meet.
He used to have a girlfriend but there are many nasty rumors about how she died or was killed rather then them breaking up. He also has a little sister.
He's known as the "Red Haired Man" in the live concert scene and his crazed fans call him "Iorin".
